verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says Rovo AI can identify trends to surface opportunities and remove bottlenecks. It also says Rovo can break down ideas into tasks and suggest assignees, and that it connects data from Confluence and third-party apps to your work. These are brief marketing claims with no detail on how insights are generated or shown. missing for 10: in-depth docs on what insights or suggestions are produced and where they appear in the UI, scope and limits of the data analyzed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to identify trends to surface new opportunities and remove bottle necks.
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
